entry.author: Nelson City Council
entry.summary:
Nelsonians have the opportunity to help shape one of the biggest community investments our city will make in a generation – the location of a new Community Hub, Library and Civic Space. 

Consultation opens today and runs until 6 September.

Three options are on the table:
– Civic House – refurbish the current building and redevelop the neighbouring Savings Bank and State Advances sites, Trafalgar/Halifax Street
– Collingwood Street – a new build on leased land
– Church Street – a new build next to Nelson Provincial Museum. 

Council hasn't chosen a preferred option. Have your say on which location works best for Nelson, and why. 

To read more see: https://buff.ly/tf0m3M0  

To read the consultation document and have your say, visit https://buff.ly/nqyhOiz
